title: 9 Question Quiz. Can You Score 9/9?

script:
Getting them all right means elite memory.
Question 1: What is the capital city of Canada?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Ottawa.
Question 2: Which gas do plants primarily absorb from the atmosphere for photosynthesis?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Carbon Dioxide.
Question 3: Who was the first person to walk on the moon?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Neil Armstrong.
If you got the first three right, like the video right now.
Question 4: Which classic 1982 Steven Spielberg film features a friendly alien who wants to 'phone home'?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial.
Question 5: On which continent is the vast Sahara Desert primarily located?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Africa.
Score check: comment SHARP if you are still perfect, RUSTY if you already missed one.
Question 6: What is the largest ocean on Earth?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is D: Pacific Ocean.
Question 7: What is the chemical symbol for water?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: H2O.
Are you ready for the last question?
Don't forget to follow and comment your score to be on the weekly leaderboard of the top performers.
Question 8: In which year did the RMS Titanic sink after hitting an iceberg?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: 1912.
Question 9: Who directed the groundbreaking 1993 science fiction film 'Jurassic Park'?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Steven Spielberg.
Comment your score out of 9, and follow for a new quiz every day.

items.question: What is the capital city of Canada?
items.explanation: Ottawa is located in Ontario and is the political center of Canada.

items.question: Which gas do plants primarily absorb from the atmosphere for photosynthesis?
items.explanation: Plants use carbon dioxide, water, and sunlight to create their own food.

items.question: Who was the first person to walk on the moon?
items.explanation: Neil Armstrong made history on July 20, 1969, as part of the Apollo 11 mission.

items.question: Which classic 1982 Steven Spielberg film features a friendly alien who wants to 'phone home'?
options: Close Encounters of the Third Kind
items.explanation: E.T. is a beloved character who befriends a young boy named Elliott.

items.question: On which continent is the vast Sahara Desert primarily located?
items.explanation: The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world, covering much of North Africa.

items.question: What is the largest ocean on Earth?
items.explanation: The Pacific Ocean covers about one-third of the surface of the Earth.

items.question: What is the chemical symbol for water?
items.explanation: Water is composed of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

items.question: In which year did the RMS Titanic sink after hitting an iceberg?
items.explanation: The tragic sinking of the Titanic occurred on its maiden voyage across the Atlantic.

items.question: Who directed the groundbreaking 1993 science fiction film 'Jurassic Park'?
items.explanation: Spielberg's direction brought dinosaurs to life with revolutionary visual effects.
